title: Rey's Murky Past
description: Rey enters Kylo Ren's quarters and is drawn to the Sith dagger. She approaches the weapon with care and when she picks it up, Rey is flooded with feelings and memories of her parents. Rey discovers that it was Ochi of Bestoon who killed them, and that they were trying to hide her from Ochi. The revelation comes as a shock to the young Jedi.
